Bedrock uniBTC on ethereum is the same mint/burn wrapper + delayed-redemption stack as BSC (protocols:656, also dead_end): every anyone-callable function is a user action that pays the caller nothing. The redeem router's claimDelayedRedeems()/claimPrincipals() pay msg.sender's own redemption (principal, not reward; no recipient argument), vault.mint pulls wrapped BTC and mints 1:1, and everything else is behind OPERATOR/DEFAULT_ADMIN/MINTER roles. Nothing on-chain pays a keeper or stranger; Bedrock's uniBTC incentives are off-chain points.
